name: Gaia Photometric Science Alerts
description: Daily transient alerts from Gaia, including the slow brightness changes that flag disk and dust events.

name: ZTF data access at IRSA
description: Zwicky Transient Facility light curves, images, and metadata search.

name: ATLAS forced photometry
description: Forced photometry at arbitrary coordinates from ATLAS difference images. Useful for filling gaps between surveys.

name: ASAS-SN Sky Patrol
description: All-sky V and g band light curves reaching back over a decade, good for long baselines on bright stars.

name: Gaia Archive
description: Astrometry, photometry, and ADQL query access for Gaia data releases.

name: IRSA
description: Infrared holdings including WISE, NEOWISE, Spitzer, and 2MASS — the backbone of our excess measurements.

name: MAST
description: Space telescope archive covering JWST, HST, TESS, and Kepler products.

name: SDSS
description: Optical and near-infrared spectroscopy, including APOGEE H-band spectra of young stars.

name: SIMBAD
description: Object identifications, classifications, and bibliography for anything you are about to claim is new.

name: VizieR
description: Published catalogues and tables, queryable by position or by paper.

name: Astropy documentation
description: Coordinates, units, time systems, tables, and FITS handling.

name: astroquery
description: Programmatic queries to most of the archives listed on this page.

name: lightkurve
description: Light curve handling, periodograms, and detrending for Kepler and TESS data.

name: emcee
description: Affine-invariant MCMC sampler we use for SED and profile fitting.

name: LSST Science Pipelines
description: Data products, tasks, and butler usage for Rubin processing.

name: Rubin Community Forum
description: Where to ask about alert packets, cadence, and pipeline behaviour.

name: JWST Exposure Time Calculator
description: Signal-to-noise and saturation checks before you commit to an instrument mode.

name: Astronomer's Proposal Tool (APT)
description: Program preparation and visibility windows for HST and JWST proposals.

name: Gemini Observing Tool
description: Phase II preparation for GMOS and other Gemini instruments.

name: NASA ADS
description: Literature search, citation metrics, and BibTeX export.

name: arXiv astro-ph.SR
description: Solar and stellar astrophysics preprints — the feed for group journal club.

name: AAS journals manuscript preparation
description: AASTeX classes, figure requirements, and data policy for ApJ, AJ, and ApJL.

name: Overleaf
description: Shared LaTeX drafting. Ask the group lead to be added to in-progress projects.

name: Hyak research computing
description: UW HPC cluster for pipeline runs and large photometric cross-matches.

name: DiRAC Institute
description: Institute seminars, people, and computing resources available to affiliated groups.

name: UW Astronomy department
description: Colloquium schedule, degree requirements, and departmental contacts.

name: Group onboarding notes
description: Placeholder for the internal starter doc: environment setup, data locations, meeting times, and who to ask about what. Add the link when it exists.
